The full shelf of Rayana AI's broadcast model portfolios as

name: rayana_ai_portfolios

ShelfCard.description:
One merchandising card on the shelf.

``openable``/``delayed`` are computed per caller by the router, not stored.
``last_update``/``n_holdings`` arrive already collapsed to the pair this
caller's access level entitles them to (``_public_card``) — the internal
``last_published_update``/``n_published_holdings`` pair is undeclared here
and so cannot ship even if that collapse were ever skipped.

Deliberately absent: ``source_lane`` and ``scoring_mode`` (internal lane
provenance — they name the engine that picks the book), the numeric ``id``,
and the gate configuration (``publish_delay_min``, ``draft_gate_enabled``,
``consumer_delay_min``), which is policy input rather than reader-facing
content — a reader sees its *effect*, as ``delayed``.
ShelfCard.title: ShelfCard
